accessOff.message: Website access is off. Grant it once to let stella use your signed-in sites.

accessReady.message: Ready. stella can use a dedicated tab while you stay signed in to websites.

accessUpdateFailed.message: Chrome could not update website access.

adoptUnsupported.message: Only public HTTPS pages can be used with stella.

adoptedTab.message: stella can now read $ORIGIN$ in this tab. Ask about it in chat.

controllerReady.message: Connected to $ORIGIN$. Each action still needs approval in stella.

downloadKept.message: Downloads that finished while stella controlled a tab and were kept: $COUNT$. Check where they came from before opening them.

downloadStopped.message: Downloads stella stopped while it controlled a tab: $COUNT$.

downloadsStoppedAndKept.message: While stella controlled a tab: downloads stopped: $STOPPED$. Downloads that finished and were kept (check where they came from before opening them): $KEPT$.

extensionDescription.message: Lets stella operate a dedicated Chrome tab after you grant site access.

unsupportedTab.message: Open a stella app tab, then try again.
